notes.title: Announcement of the new Ells Tales!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45051997/542b037f5404605d6f024452d372fa616baa745d.jpg[/img]

After almost a year, we’re excited to announce the upcoming release of the new game [b]Ells Tales[/b], returning to the roots of the series! Missing the separate control of each of the character’s hands and that retro-style graphics?

So, we’re proud to present the new chapter — [b]Ells Tales: Chairbound[/b]. Step into the shoes of a person tied to an office chair in the middle of a gloomy office building. Control the movement and rotation of the chair using physics, but be careful not to tip over, and find your way to escape before time runs out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-wZ11Xy7Zhc

Add the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss the upcoming release:

store.steampowered.com/app/3281410/Ells_Tales_Chairbound

Wishing you a great summer! All the best from the Ells&Pills team!

notes.title: A prequel? Are you serious?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44853127/a89fc52d531165cc13f2a33e8d970f5ead2001cd.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi, it's Ells&Pills![/b]

We would like to share with you the news that we have recently released a side, as it might seem from the outside, and quite controversial project - [b]Pigeon Hater[/b]. The game is designed for a slightly different audience with its own gaming interests, it is no longer a horror for attention. But!

Given the absurdity of what's happening on screen and the gameplay, Pigeon Hater could be a real psychological horror for some players who just don't accept this kind of “specific experience” and this kind of humor. Plus, this game is from our series of wacky games, it has its own special place in this mad universe. In addition to being a sort of prologue to the main Ells Tales series overall, it's also a prequel to My Last Appointment. Unusual, sick, as it should be! XD

That's why we want to inform you that if you have previously purchased My Last Appointment, you have the opportunity to buy Pigeon Hater at a double discount ( launch discount and bundle discount) until October 24th. And once again dive into the madness, but of a different nature:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3151930/Pigeon_Hater/]GAME PAGE (ADULT ONLY)[/url]

notes.title: The game is available!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, Ells&Pills is here![/b]

We are very excited that today was the long-awaited release of our third game! Unlike the previous two games, this game has a different visual style and its events take place in a different environment. But like the previous games, this is also a small horror game that will test your attention to details!

[b]Important clarification: there are no text-related puzzles in the game.[/b] We wanted the game to be accessible to players from all over the world. Therefore, every player, no matter where they are from, should be able to get through the game without feeling the weight of the language barrier.

Also, with the release of this game, we've added it to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43019/Ells_Tales/]bundle[/url]. So in addition to the release celebration discount, the game will also receive an additional 10% discount as part of the bundle. 

Thank you all for your support, stay tuned! Lots of fun ahead! ^_^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44853127/7c2bd787535d192a237e8b8bfebb355853c7f131.jpg[/img]

[i]Oh, and yes.. You might need a key card! ;)[/i]

notes.title: Release is just around the corner!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, Ells&Pills is here![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44853127/de79c3fad796eaf0382f13b8c29e815daccc6d0f.jpg[/img]

Initially we expected to release the game in the spring of this year, in March or April. But some problems arose, so the release had to be postponed. And thus, the game is no longer the first in our game series, but the third! The game will be released on August 2.

We would also like to tell you a little about the technical side of the game. Initially we had an idea to try to create the game with Unreal Engine 5 using the new dynamic lighting system Lumen. This is a great technology, although it raises the bar of minimum system requirements. 

[b]There will be three graphics presets in the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Off (potato-mode).[/b] The picture will be so-so, but the game should run well in 1920x1080p resolution on almost any graphics card, starting with GTX 1050ti.
[*] [b]Low.[/b] This preset is suitable for playing at 1920x1080p resolution on graphics cards starting from GTX 1660 Ti/Super.
[*] [b]High.[/b] This preset is suitable for playing at 1920x1080p resolution on graphics cards starting from RTX 2070/3060.
[/list]
In addition, from the problems at [b]the first launch[/b] of the game can be compilation of shaders. Many players are familiar with this “trick” of Unreal Engine 5. Alas, but we couldn't avoid this problem either. Sorry for this inconvenience, we didn't do it on purpose :(

All the best from the Ells&Pills team, see you soon! <3

notes.title: Announcement of the game!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the page of our game!
Its a short walking simulator inspired by liminal spaces, internet memes about backrooms, and the aesthetics of the unpleasant corridors of post-Soviet medical facilities. This game will test your attention to detail, as well as delight you with various pranks and creepy moments.
